career.header: This is the Career Path Page

thewelcome.heading: Welcome to Career Scouter!
thewelcome.title: Welcome to Career Scouter, a valuable tool designed to support students in their academic and professional journey. Career Scouter is all about helping students explore their desired specializations and make informed decisions along the way.
thewelcome.description1: Start by familiarizing yourself with Career Scouter's purpose and features. Career Scouter provides a platform for students to understand the different areas they can work in the IT industry and discover the opportunities that JAMK University of Applied Sciences offers to achieve their goals.
thewelcome.description2: Once you have an understanding of Career Scouter, you can navigate through the various roles available in the IT industry. Explore different job positions and learn about the responsibilities, requirements, and potential career paths associated with each role.
thewelcome.description3: Gain valuable insights from employees working in the respective roles. Read testimonials and personal experiences shared by professionals to get a glimpse into their day-to-day work, challenges, and rewards. This will help you better understand the realities of each specialization.
thewelcome.description4: Discover the main skills required for each specific role. Gain an understanding of the technical expertise, soft skills, and qualifications necessary to excel in your desired specialization. This information will help you evaluate your existing skills and identify areas for improvement.
thewelcome.description5: Expand your knowledge further by exploring related roles within the IT industry. Discover additional career paths that complement your desired specialization, providing you with a broader perspective and more options to consider.
thewelcome.description6: Explore the courses and resources offered by JAMK University of Applied Sciences that are relevant to your chosen specialization. Identify the educational opportunities available to acquire the necessary knowledge and skills for your career path.
thewelcome.description7: After thoroughly exploring the Careers Pages and gaining insights into various specializations, proceed to the quiz. The quiz will help you consolidate your preferences by selecting your top four specializations based on the information you have gathered. The quiz will be conducted using Microsoft Forms.
thewelcome.heading8: Step 8: Semesterly Quiz and Preference Changes
thewelcome.description8: Every semester, you will have the opportunity to retake the quiz and update your preferences if they have changed. The quiz will help you reassess your interests and choices, allowing you to refine your career path accordingly. Additionally, you will be asked to provide reasons for any changes in preferences to gather valuable feedback.
thewelcome.description9: Career Scouter values your input. There will be a dedicated space for you in the Quiz area to provide feedback, suggestions, and comments. Your feedback will help us continuously improve and enhance Career Scouter to better serve your needs.
thewelcome.description10: The GDPR info ends on To ensure transparency and data privacy, we have a dedicated GDPR page. This page will provide detailed information on what data is being collected, how it is being used, and the steps taken to protect your privacy. We encourage you to review this page to understand your rights and how your information is handled.
thewelcome.description11: Career Scouter is here to support you in exploring the world of IT specializations, making informed decisions, and connecting you with the resources and opportunities provided by JAMK University of Applied Sciences. Start your journey today and unlock your potential for a successful career in the IT industry.

careerdata.career1desc: Testimony: As a Software Engineer at Tech Solutions Inc., I am responsible for developing and maintaining high-quality software solutions. My day-to-day activities involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, designing software architectures, coding and debugging applications, and conducting thorough testing. I also contribute to code reviews and provide technical support to clients. It's a fulfilling role that allows me to apply my problem-solving skills and creativity to deliver innovative software products.
careerdata.career1course5: Introduction to data analytics and artificial intelligence

careerdata.career2desc: Testimony: Working as a Data Scientist at Analytics Solutions Ltd. is both challenging and exciting. I spend my days extracting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to derive valuable insights. I apply statistical modeling and machine learning techniques to develop predictive models and algorithms. Additionally, I collaborate with domain experts to understand business needs and translate them into data-driven solutions. It's fulfilling to see how data-driven decisions can make a significant impact on our clients' businesses.
careerdata.career2course1desc: - Guided and unsupervised machine learning and the most common regression and classification models; - Application using Python libraries (NumPy, Pandas and scikit-learn); - Data format and quality; - Splitting a dataset into training and test data; - Assessing model accuracy; Different types of machine learning models: ; - k-nearest neighbours; - k-mean clustering; - Naive Bayes; - Support Vector Machine; - Principal Component Analysis (PCA); - Decision trees and random forest; - Perseptron (simple neural network)
careerdata.career2course2desc: - Different neural networks and their architectures and uses (CNN, RNN, LSTM, Autoencoder, etc); - Working with open source tools; - Distributed learning; - Prediction; - Machine vision; - NLP
careerdata.career2course3desc: - Data quantity and quality; - Data analysis as part of the overall data processing process; - Data description; - Data manipulation; - Data visualisation; - Statistics; - Time series; - Correlation; - Linear and non-linear regression model; - Modelling of continuous data; - Presentation of the analysed result
careerdata.career2course4desc: A data analytics and machine learning project based on predefined data in a Python programming environment, including the following project steps:; - Data pre-processing; - Data description, metrics and graphs; - Selection and implementation of a suitable prediction model (at least 2 alternative models); - Evaluation of the accuracy of the prediction models; - Analysis of the results.
careerdata.career3desc: Testimony: As a Cybersecurity Analyst at Secure Systems Inc., my primary focus is ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our organization's systems and data. I conduct security assessments, vulnerability scans, and penetration testing to identify and mitigate potential risks. I also monitor and respond to security incidents, perform security audits, and develop and enforce security policies. Every day is a new challenge, and it's rewarding to protect our company and its assets from cyber threats.
careerdata.career3course1desc: The course will cover most common application vulnerabilities, what causes them, how they are exploited and how to fix or mitigate them. Basic knowledge of C or C++ and data structures and algorithms is required. Knowledge of one scripting language (e.g. Python) is recommended.
careerdata.career3course2desc: The course covers general concepts and organisational models of a cybersecurity centre. The course will design an organisational model and technical tools for the cyber security centre to handle incidents.
careerdata.career3course3desc: The course includes a review of various security controls from the perspective of design and implementation. The course will make use of existing approaches to security controls.
careerdata.career3course4desc: - Principles and forms of cyber threat intelligence; - Exploitability of cyber threat intelligence; - Data analytics methods for data processing and validation; - Enrichment of cyber threat intelligence with external sources
careerdata.career3course5desc: The course focuses on the ISO2700x family of standards and related frameworks and their key management processes, such as configuration management, event management, vulnerable object management, threat management and risk management.
careerdata.career3course6desc: Introduction to cybersecurity; - Today's situation and phenomena; - Terminology; Societal cybersecurity; - Legislation, standards, licences; - Information security and influence; - GDPR and privacy statements; - Government actors (Cybersecurity Centre, Police); Personal cybersecurity; - Media literacy and information trustworthiness; - Risk management; - Access management and password; - Cryptology (checksum functions, asymmetric and symmetric encryption); - Malware, threats and vulnerabilities; - Data stream encryption; - Hardening of personal devices; - Classification of proprietary data (private, public); Organisational cyber security; - How the above affect the overall security of public and private organisations
careerdata.career3course7desc: - Basics of malware and vulnerabilities; - Malware families and types; - Cyber attacks and attack methods; - Deployment of defence and security technologies in ICT environments; - Cybersecurity incident handling process and practices; - Protection of systems and environments; - Digital forensics basics and methods
careerdata.career4desc: Testimony: As an IT Project Manager at TechPro Solutions, I oversee the successful planning, execution, and delivery of IT projects. I collaborate with stakeholders to define project objectives, create project plans, and allocate resources effectively. I manage project timelines, budgets, and risks, ensuring that projects are delivered within scope and on time. Additionally, I lead project teams, facilitate communication, and ensure that everyone is working towards a common goal. It's a dynamic role that requires strong leadership and organizational skills.
careerdata.career4course1desc: The content will be determined by the challenges/missions of the team. The solutions are implemented together with the supervisor.; More information:
careerdata.career4course2desc: - Basic concepts of project management; - Roles of actors and stakeholders in different phases of the project; - Project design, project segmentation and phasing; - Task allocation; - Workload and cost estimation; - Cost and risk mapping and management; - Agile project vs. traditional project; - Project supervision and control
careerdata.career4course3desc: The development, maintenance and operation of IT networks is driven by a number of different service management/operational management methodologies. The implementation of the course describes the current relevant methodologies to be taught. This list, described in the course description, is indicative:; - Network Operations Centre; - Service management methodologies e.g. ITIL; - Service Level Agreements (SLA and its parameters e.g. MTBF, MTTR); - Maintenance (fault management) of the network.
careerdata.career4course4desc: The course focuses on the ISO2700x family of standards and related frameworks and their key management processes, such as configuration management, event management, vulnerable object management, threat management and risk management.
careerdata.career4course5desc: The course covers the entire lifecycle of a software project. Modern project management and communication tools are used to help.; - Idea and its refinement;; - Using project management and communication tools.; - Technical design of software/service.; - Software development cycles.; - Automated testing.; - Software release.
careerdata.career5desc: Testimony: As a Cloud Solutions Architect at CloudTech Solutions, I design and implement scalable and secure cloud-based solutions for our clients. I assess business requirements, evaluate cloud technologies, and develop architectural designs that align with industry best practices. I work closely with development teams to ensure the successful deployment and integration of cloud solutions. Additionally, I provide technical guidance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize cloud infrastructure for performance and cost efficiency. It's an exciting role that allows me to leverage the power of the cloud to drive innovation.

gdpr.parag1: The processing of the personal data of the students of Jamk University of Applied Sciences is based on a statutory task and the students’ legitimate interest to complete courses and utilise the benefits and services related to studying (EU General Data Protection Regulation 2016/679; Universities of Applied Sciences Act 932/2014; 1129/2014). If the information of students is to be used for any other purpose than a purpose based on legislation or the legitimate interest of students, permission is asked from the student.
gdpr.parag2: Students’ personal data and the students’ learner numbers are retrieved from the national database of higher education institutions maintained by the Finnish National Agency for Education. Data related to the students’ study entitlement and study attainments is maintained in the student administration system in order for the students to complete courses, receive guidance and complete their degree and receive a certificate. Keeping the information up-to-date ensures the students’ legal protection and the realisation of statutory data collection conducted by institutions of higher education.
gdpr.heading3: Where is the information coming from?
gdpr.parag3: Primarily, personal data is always collected directly from the students during the application process or studies. Students’ personal data and learner numbers are retrieved from the national database of higher education institutions maintained by the Finnish National Agency for Education ((Studyinfo.fi / Opintopolku.fi), where they have been stored by the applicants themselves. Data recorded in the system during the application phase is used by the university of applied sciences. The data recorded in the system during the application phase by those selected as students and those who have accepted their place at the university is transferred to the student administration system. During their study entitlement, students have the opportunity to update the information concerning themselves. Students may also report their data through the short course system. This applies to students of open studies and anyone participating in other forms of education. Personal data is also processed during studies in the electronic learning environment, for example, where personal data is processed to enable online studies.
gdpr.heading4: How can I update/inspect my data?
gdpr.parag4: Students may update their contact details in the student administration system and the library, for example. Data may be updated anytime during the studies. If students wish to inspect data that is not directly visible to them, they may submit an information request for their data. Students and those who have completed their studies have the right to inspect the personal data recorded about them. Student services secretaries update student information in the student administration systems upon request. The data of graduating students is updated based on the contact details in the certificate application, if necessary. Library customers may inspect their data in the library customer register by contacting the library directly, regardless of whether they are students.
gdpr.heading5: Who is the data disclosed to?
gdpr.parag5: Data is transferred to various authorities and the national higher education achievement register, where it is constantly updated for the needs of various authorities. The personal data of students may be disclosed for research and marketing purposes with the student’s consent. Information disclosures for research purposes from the student register are always conducted via the Research Authorisation procedure. Information concerning students who are applying for exchange studies abroad or some other international studies may be disclosed to partner institutions. Information may be disclosed to cooperation partners concerning shared courses implemented in cooperation with other institutions. Only data that is pertinent to the matter at hand will be disclosed. Students or alumni may revoke the data disclosure consent they have given earlier either themselves or, after their studies are completed, by contacting Student Services.
gdpr.parag6: OILI, an enrolment and registration service for students -service (IT Center for Science Ltd. CSC)
gdpr.parag7: Oppijan seurantakyselyt (Only in Finnish; OKM, IT Center for Science Ltd. CSC)
gdpr.parag10: Tuudo-service (IT Center for Science Ltd. CSC, Caleidon Oy)
gdpr.parag11: Koski, opintosuoritukset ja opiskeluoikeudet (Only in Finnish; OPH)
gdpr.parag12: UAF, University Admissions Finland –konsortio, kansainvälisen haun palvelu (IT Center for Science Ltd. CSC)
gdpr.parag14: With the student’s consent, data is disclosed for marketing purposes, to the Jamk library and to the student union JAMKO, for example.
gdpr.parag15: Each data processor processes personal data only in connection with their tasks and with their personal ID. The data is processed by applicant and student services in connection with the designated tasks, teachers for the purpose of recording study attainments, career tutors, people in charge of degrees and study counsellors for the purposes of providing guidance and advice. The data is also processed by the archivist in connection with electronic services as well as ICT services in the event they are asked to solve IT issues.
gdpr.parag16: Student information is stored in accordance with the Jamk information management plan primarily for the duration of the studies (up to 6 years). Material related to entrance examinations is stored for two years in the event any complaints are filed. Exercise and exam material is stored for six months after the grade for the attainment has been entered into the register. (Universities of Applied Sciences Act 932/2014)
gdpr.parag17: Data in the national higher education achievement register is stored permanently. Jamk stores any information on documents pertaining to theses as well as degree certificates and transcripts of records electronically and permanently (Decision of the National Archives of Finland  AL/20757/07.01.01.03.02/2016 .
